settings.content: Klaviyo and Omnisend load store-wide via script tags (not app embeds), so their WELCOME10 popup / CLAIM DISCOUNT teaser can't be switched off per theme in the app. This hides them in this theme only. To kill WELCOME10 everywhere, pause the form in Klaviyo/Omnisend.
